product_metadata.title: Collapsible Colander Set of 2 Kitchen Colander Strainer, Sink Colander Strainer -Food Colanders Strainers with Handles, Silicone Colanders to Strain your Pasta, Vegetables and Fruits
features: 【Perfect 2 Pieces Strainer Set】The set comes with 2pack different collapsible colanders (a round colander with handle and a square colander), you can prepare two food products at the same time and use by different colanders.

【Durable Safe Silicone Colander】 Kitchen colander strainers use high-quality silicone material, BPA free, and is eco- friendly 100% safe use. Heat-Resistant up to 230of, quickly immersed in hot water won't cause damage, safe for your food and your familyand dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.
【Space-Saving Collaped Design】These drainer baskets can be collapsed down to under 2 inches, save much space for your kitchen, you can store in any kitchen drawer, cabinet or drying tray.

【Quick Draining Design】 A large number of uniform holes at the bottom and a raised design are conducive to speeding up the drainage so that you can save more time during use and also have time to do what you like,Let you enjoy life more.

【Multi Use】You can use the kitchen foldable colander over or in the sink. Of course, the counter and table are also very convenient. It is very suitable for draining most foods, fruits, vegetables, such as pasta, macaroni, green beans, broccoli,salad leafs,etc.Hint Please don't use it as a steamer in pot.
